title: Quick Mediterranean Peanut Bowl
description: Creamy Mediterranean bowl with roasted peanuts, quinoa, steamed zucchini, and tangy feta for a buttery, ovo-vegetarian solo dinner.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F and spread 30g raw peanuts with 1 tsp olive oil, 1/4 tsp salt, and 1/4 tsp pepper on a baking sheet, then roast for 8 minutes until fragrant.
While the peanuts roast, rinse 100g quinoa under cold water, then simmer in 200ml water for 15 minutes until fluffy.
Slice 2 medium zucchini into noodles using a spiralizer, then steam in a steamer basket for 3 minutes until just tender.
In a large bowl, combine cooked quinoa, roasted peanuts, and steamed zucchini noodles.
Whisk together 1 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp butter, 1 tbsp lemon juice, minced garlic clove, and 1 tsp smoked paprika until smooth.
Pour the dressing over the quinoa mixture and toss until everything is evenly coated.
Sprinkle 30g crumbled feta cheese and 10g chopped parsley over the bowl.
Serve warm as a buttery, Mediterranean solo dinner.
